title: Long-term calcium imaging of ASJ sensory neuron controlling cold tolerance in Caenorhabditis elegans
protocol: Immobilize well-fed animals expressing yellow cameleon 3.60 driven by the trx-1 promoter on 10% (w/v) agar pads using polystyrene microspheres.
Mount the coverslip with the sample and fill the edge of the coverslip with oil to prevent drying out.
Set the temperature of the thermocontroller at 17°C before mounting the sample.
Acquire fluorescence images of YFP and CFP from 17°C to 23°C for 2 min as initial states.
After 30 minutes, acquire fluorescence images of YFP and CFP for 60 seconds as 30-minute states.
After another 30 minutes, take images for 60 seconds as 60-minute states.
After another hour, take images for 60 seconds as the 120-minute states.
Repeat this operation every 60 minutes until 300 minutes.
After 300 minutes, turn the temperature down to 17°C.
Remove the cover glass after long-term calcium imaging.
Add approximately 10 μl of M9 buffer onto the animals.
Confirm that the animals are alive.
